If possible can we:
- Reschedule for a 15–20 minute slot later this week? I’m limited due to onsite workshops but can do short windows.
- Or, if you have a brief recording/overview of the “cost & latency” section, could you share that? Procurement is asking for something to review while I’m tied up.

I can do: Thu 12/07 08:30–09:00 PT or Fri 12/08 11:30–12:00 PT — but those aren’t firm yet (execs may change). Otherwise I’ll add a couple options.

Availability I can offer this week (PT):
- Thu 12/07 08:30–08:45 (tight but doable)
- Thu 12/07 11:00–11:20
- Fri 12/08 11:30–11:50

If none of those work, happy for you to drop 3 times and we’ll align. I’m also looping Marissa for commercial alignment and Monica to run the technical portion if we decide to shift to an engineer-led deep dive.

Attaching a one-pager that highlights typical unit economics and a short link to a recording I can share quickly.

Best,
